description: This file defines an abstract base class for a generic data repository, providing CRUD operation method signatures for data access layers in a software project.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: An abstract base class for generic data repositories, defining the standard CRUD method signatures for implementation in subclasses.

methods.name: T create(self, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new record with provided data.

methods.name: Optional[T] get_by_id(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a record by its ID.

methods.name: List[T] get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves all records with optional pagination and filtering.

methods.name: int count(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
Optional[T] update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing record identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: bool delete(self, item_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a record by its ID.

ctags.name: count
ctags.pattern: /^    def count(self, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> int:$/

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> T:$/

ctags.name: get_all
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_all(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) /
ctags.signature: (self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, item_id: int, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[T]:$/
